posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Kirino-7 said:
If this plugin turned on, when I start the test, it's second window opening "devtools - chrome-extension" with some code. Not sure that it is how it should be.
Click to expand...
This is clearly intentional on VisuStella's part, but I bet it has a setting to disable it somewhere. Personally though, I'd recommend just leaving it alone – that window is extremely useful for debugging when something goes wrong. You can open it at any time by pressing F8, but MZ (unlike MV) has an issue where it isn't available during game boot (meaning that pressing F5 will close it), which can make tracking down some classes of bugs very difficult unless you configure it to automatically open even before the game starts booting.
The window
won't
open when you deploy a build – it only exists in the testing version of your game.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Kirino-7 said:
When the battle starts it's always "enemy appears"
Click to expand...
The text here can be customized in the System 1 tab. I haven't tried, but it's possible that if you make that text blank, nothing will show at all.
Kirino-7 said:
How to make common events BEFORE spell? I'm trying to make image appears for 3 seconds, then dissapear and after that should be spell animation.
Click to expand...
I think making a common event trigger before skill invocation would be very difficult. Events are naturally asynchronous, meaning they execute one command and then go on and take care of other things until that command completes. (Yes, even non-parallel events.) But that means that events are processed only at specific times, and in the middle of skill invocation is not one of those times. Though a plugin could probably be made to process events during skill invocation, I think a better approach would be something that does arbitrary things during skill invocation… which means
action sequences
.
If you're using Yanfly's battle engine, action sequences are baked in, so I assume VisuStella also has them. I don't know if there are other plugins that implement action sequences. It's likely possible to do some basic action sequences using just the formula box, though it would be awkward and only sufficient for things that trigger upon hit (not for things triggering on invocation like you want).
Fundamentally, action sequences are controlled by the battle log window. You
push
the actions onto the queue, and the log window executes each one as needed. However, I'm pretty sure there isn't an action to show a picture by default (though perhaps Yanfly/VisuStella added one, I wouldn't know). So, assuming you're
not
using VisuStella, if you want to add a new element to the battle sequence that displays a picture, you simply need to alias one method (probably the
performAction
method, but I'd need to check to be sure), add a new call to push your new action into the queue, and finally implement the action.

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
Ditch FOSSIL. It was marketed as compatibility layer, while in reality, it's simply a collection of hard-coded patches wrapped as a single plugin, made by a very inexperienced programmer. I don't think it's worth tampering with it, as it's just a matter of time until the next thing breaks. It only gives you the impression that MZ plugins would be messy or frequently cause conflicts, just because 1 programmer screwed up.
Maybe you can find someone in the FOSSIL thread to safely remove all MOG overrides, since MOG now officially supports MZ.
